## What you will learn

- **Health metrics:** Calculate and interpret Disability Adjusted Life Years (DALYs), Years of Life Lost (YLLs), and Years Lived with Disability (YLDs).
- **Machine learning:** Explore predictive models and their application to health data.
- **Data visualisation:** Communicate patterns and model results through charts and maps.
- **Spatial modelling:** Investigate geographical patterns in health outcomes and infectious diseases.
- **Case studies:** Follow R examples using COVID-19 and malaria data.

## Who it is for

The book is written for researchers, data scientists, public health professionals, and students working with health data. Basic R knowledge will help you follow the code; familiarity with statistics and epidemiology is useful.

## Publication and citation

The free online edition developed alongside the book. Its legacy June 2023 date records the agreement with the editor, rather than the print publication date. The first print edition was published by CRC Press in 2025.

**Print edition · CRC Press / Chapman & Hall · 2025**

> Gazzelloni, Federica. (2025). *Health Metrics and the Spread of Infectious Diseases: Machine Learning Applications and Spatial Modelling Analysis with R*. CRC Press.

See the [publisher’s page](https://www.routledge.com/Health-Metrics-and-the-Spread-of-Infectious-Diseases-Machine-Learning-Applications-and--Spatial-Modelling-Analysis-with-R/Gazzelloni/p/book/9781032625782) for available formats and ISBN details.
